channel.title: All You Need Is Attention
channel.description: Essays on AI and what came after “Attention Is All You Need.”

item.title: Attention, step by step
item.description: One sentence, one word, one real attention head. A walk through the arithmetic at the heart of a language model, using actual numbers from GPT-2.

item.title: What a token is
item.description: Language models never see letters or words. They see tokens. What those are, how they are chosen, and why they explain some of AI’s strangest mistakes.

item.title: What came next
item.description: One paper about machine translation quietly became the blueprint for almost every AI system that followed. A short tour of how that happened.
